mapper.select: SELECT dugr.id, oagr.dates, oagr.user_id, dui.pkg, oagr.num game_level, IFNULL(oagr.`time`, 0) game_time, oagr.status game_status, oagrd.is_add reward_consumption_type, oagrd.amount reward_consumption_amount, oagrd.`type` amount_type FROM ods_ab_game_record oagr INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui ON (dui.user_id = oagr.user_id) INNER JOIN ods_ab_game_record_detail oagrd ON (oagr.id = oagrd.game_record_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_game_record dugr ON (dugr.dates = oagr.dates and dugr.user_id = oagr.user_id and dugr.game_level = oagr.num) WHERE oagr.dates = #{dates} limit #{rows} OFFSET #{startRows}
